Family 002 tensors, labels, models, ONNX files, predictions, trades and outcomes
Family 003 pair fits, residuals, decisions, baskets and outcomes
Family 004 M15 features, virtual outcomes, online state, scores, decisions, trades and outcomes
Family 005 tensors, labels, GRU models, ONNX files, predictions, utilities, trades and outcomes
V1-V8 signals, opportunity timestamps, component labels, state and economics
material_distinctions: exchange-local London and New York opening anchors rather than all-day or rolling model decisions
direction determined by the current first five completed opening bars rather than a historically chosen fixed session direction
two frozen polar opening-auction responses rather than an outcome-driven direction inversion
deterministic Python adapter instead of regression, classifier, residual estimator, online expert or recurrent neural model
two independent simultaneous symbol lifecycles per complete session rather than one globally ranked action

source_inputs.price_basis: MT5 rate OHLC are Bid; recorded spread times point reconstructs Ask

sessions.dst_rule: the IANA timezone database in the Python adapter owns the UTC conversion
the IANA timezone database in the Python adapter owns the UTC conversion

discarded_sessions.TOKYO_0900: timestamp-only source geometry unavailable at the local anchor
discarded_sessions.HONG_KONG_0930: timestamp-only source coverage incomplete in late 2025 and early 2026

decision_geometry.required_complete_rows: for both symbols every exact UTC minute from anchor minus 30 through anchor plus 74 inclusive
decision_geometry.preopening_context: anchor minus 30 through anchor minus 1; retained for completeness evidence but not used to choose direction or distance
decision_geometry.opening_bars: five completed M1 bars at anchor through anchor plus 4
decision_geometry.decision_time: immediately after the anchor-plus-4 bar completes
decision_geometry.entry_time: Bid open of anchor plus 5; long pays that row's Ask spread and short enters Bid
decision_geometry.future_path: sixty M1 bars anchor plus 5 through anchor plus 64 inclusive
decision_geometry.audit_overcoverage: anchor plus 65 through anchor plus 74 is required structurally but unused economically
decision_geometry.complete_session_event: both symbols satisfy the complete-row geometry
decision_geometry.normal_trading_day: UTC date with at least one complete declared session event; zero-signal and risk-blocked dates remain in the denominator
decision_geometry.lifecycle_start_count: each accepted symbol first fill counts once

opening_state.opening_body: Bid close at anchor plus 4 minus Bid open at anchor
opening_state.opening_range_price: maximum Bid high minus minimum Bid low across anchor through anchor plus 4
opening_state.zero_body: no action for either role on that symbol-session
opening_state.nonpositive_or_nonfinite_range: no action for either role on that symbol-session

position_and_proxy_execution.long_stop: entry Ask minus one opening range, evaluated on Bid
position_and_proxy_execution.long_take: entry Ask plus 1.5 opening ranges, evaluated on Bid
position_and_proxy_execution.short_stop: entry Bid plus one opening range, evaluated on Ask
position_and_proxy_execution.short_take: entry Bid minus 1.5 opening ranges, evaluated on Ask
position_and_proxy_execution.same_bar_stop_and_take: adverse stop wins and exact threshold execution is used
position_and_proxy_execution.maximum_hold: sixty M1 bars including the entry bar, then direction-specific close at anchor plus 64
position_and_proxy_execution.short_time_exit: Ask close reconstructed from Bid close plus that row's recorded spread
position_and_proxy_execution.volume_rounding: floor two-percent range-risk volume to 0.01; use minimum 0.01 only when planned loss is at most four percent of session-start actual balance
position_and_proxy_execution.actual_execution: direction-specific Bid/Ask entry, barrier and time-exit prices
position_and_proxy_execution.extra_stress: subtract the same observed direction-specific actual spread burden once more
position_and_proxy_execution.exit_settlement_order: chronological exit time, then frozen symbol order US100 before US30 on an exact tie
position_and_proxy_execution.insolvency_or_nonfinite_balance: block later entries without rewriting already open paths

python_adapter_owns: exact M1 completeness and session sequencing
the frozen DRIVE or FADE direction per symbol
decision schema, sequence and bounded decision evidence
ea_must_own: adapter schema, sequence and freshness validation
symbol contract, tick size, tick value, lot and market-state validation
session-start balance risk sizing and aggregate cap
fail-closed order submission and two-symbol reconciliation
protective stop, take and sixty-M1 timed close
ownership, persistence, restart recovery and bounded execution evidence

development_gates.selection: highest stressed net among complete passers, then lower drawdown, then higher minimum yearly stressed net, then frozen role order

native_escalation.condition: exactly one unchanged role passes development, locked confirmation and whole proxy challenge gates
native_escalation.tester_model: FPMarkets Every tick based on real ticks with 100% real ticks

ordered_stages: declaration before source copies, opening state, decisions or candidate economics
byte-equal source materialization and complete adapter implementation freeze with timestamp, direction-count and risk-feasibility structure only
locked 2026 confirmation for at most one unchanged complete passer
self-contained Python adapter plus EA compile and one native candidate path only for a complete whole-proxy survivor

stop_rules.no_development_passer: close before locked 2026, EA and MT5 without an adjacent response, direction, session, body, range, threshold, symbol, subgroup, risk or exit rescue
stop_rules.environment_or_engineering_fault: correct and rerun without economic verdict or arbitrary retry cap
stop_rules.success: record verified native V8 Challenge victory; Live still requires a separate user-authorized engineering and handoff decision
